name: hiragana-mu
draw: Hiragana mu (む): a horizontal bar crossed by a stroke that loops at the lower left and sweeps right, with a small dash at the upper right.

name: hiragana-me
draw: Hiragana me (め): two crossing strokes forming an overlapping loop, like nu without the curl at the end.

name: hiragana-mo
draw: Hiragana mo (も): a vertical stroke hooking right at the bottom, crossed by two short horizontal bars.

name: hiragana-ya
draw: Hiragana ya (や): a curved stroke with a small hook, a short dot like stroke and a long diagonal stroke crossing both.

name: hiragana-yu
draw: Hiragana yu (ゆ): a tall curved stroke on the left and a round loop on the right crossed by a vertical stroke.

name: hiragana-yo
draw: Hiragana yo (よ): a short horizontal dash crossing a vertical stroke that ends in a small loop at the bottom.

name: hiragana-ra
draw: Hiragana ra (ら): a short dash on top above a stroke that drops and swings into a round bowl opening to the lower left.

name: hiragana-ri
draw: Hiragana ri (り): two upright strokes, a short left one with a hook and a longer right one curving down to the left.

name: hiragana-ru
draw: Hiragana ru (る): a zigzag stroke sweeping down into a round bowl that ends in a small closed loop at the bottom.

name: hiragana-re
draw: Hiragana re (れ): a tall vertical on the left crossed by a zigzag that ends in an upward flick to the right.

name: hiragana-ro
draw: Hiragana ro (ろ): a zigzag stroke sweeping down into a round open bowl, like ru without the loop.

name: hiragana-wa
draw: Hiragana wa (わ): a tall vertical on the left crossed by a zigzag that swings into a wide rounded belly on the right.

name: hiragana-wo
draw: Hiragana wo (を): a short horizontal bar with a slanted zigzag below it and a flat curved tail at the lower right.

name: hiragana-n
draw: Hiragana n (ん): a single stroke that drops as a long diagonal, bounces up into a small hump and ends in a rising flick.

name: katakana-i
draw: Katakana i (イ): a short diagonal stroke sloping down to the left with a vertical stem hanging from its middle.

name: katakana-u
draw: Katakana u (ウ): a short vertical tick on top of a flat roof whose right side bends down into a hook to the lower left.

name: katakana-o
draw: Katakana o (オ): a horizontal bar crossed by a hooked vertical stem, with a diagonal stroke sloping down left from the crossing.

name: katakana-ka
draw: Katakana ka (カ): a horizontal stroke bending down at the right into a hook, crossed by a slanted stroke on the left.

name: katakana-ki
draw: Katakana ki (キ): two horizontal bars crossed by a single slightly slanted vertical stroke.

name: katakana-ku
draw: Katakana ku (ク): a short stroke sloping down left, joined at its top by a stroke that runs right and bends into a long diagonal to the lower left.

name: katakana-ke
draw: Katakana ke (ケ): a short diagonal sloping down left, a horizontal bar from its middle and a long stroke dropping from the bar and curving left.

name: katakana-ko
draw: Katakana ko (コ): a squared bracket of a top bar, a right upright and a bottom bar, open to the left.

name: katakana-sa
draw: Katakana sa (サ): a horizontal bar crossed by two vertical strokes, the right one curving down to the left.

name: katakana-shi
draw: Katakana shi (シ): two short dashes stacked on the left and a long stroke rising from the lower left to the upper right.

name: katakana-su
draw: Katakana su (ス): a horizontal stroke bending into a long diagonal down to the left, with a short stroke branching down right from its middle.

name: katakana-se
draw: Katakana se (セ): a horizontal stroke with a small hook at its right end, crossed by a vertical stem that turns right into a flat base.

name: katakana-so
draw: Katakana so (ソ): a short upright dash on the left and a long stroke sweeping down from the upper right to the lower left.

name: katakana-ta
draw: Katakana ta (タ): the ku shape of a short left diagonal and a bent long diagonal, with a small dash inside.

name: katakana-chi
draw: Katakana chi (チ): a short slanted dash on top, a horizontal bar and a vertical stem curving down to the left.

name: katakana-tsu
draw: Katakana tsu (ツ): two short upright dashes side by side at the top and a long stroke sweeping down from the upper right to the lower left.

name: katakana-te
draw: Katakana te (テ): a short horizontal bar above a longer bar, with a stem dropping from the centre and curving to the left.

name: katakana-na
draw: Katakana na (ナ): a horizontal bar crossed by a vertical stroke that curves down to the left.

name: katakana-nu
draw: Katakana nu (ヌ): a horizontal stroke bending into a long diagonal down to the left, crossed by a short stroke sloping down right.

name: katakana-ne
draw: Katakana ne (ネ): a short dot on top, a bar bending into a diagonal down left, a short vertical stem and a small stroke to the right.

name: katakana-ha
draw: Katakana ha (ハ): two separate strokes spreading apart like a wide open inverted V with a gap at the top.

name: katakana-hi
draw: Katakana hi (ヒ): a short horizontal stroke to the right from a vertical stem that turns into a flat base at the bottom.

name: katakana-ho
draw: Katakana ho (ホ): a horizontal bar crossed by a hooked vertical stem, with two small diagonal dashes spreading down on either side.

name: katakana-ma
draw: Katakana ma (マ): a horizontal bar bending into a short diagonal down to the left, with a small dash below slanting down right.

name: katakana-mi
draw: Katakana mi (ミ): three short parallel strokes stacked, each sloping slightly down to the right.

name: katakana-mu
draw: Katakana mu (ム): a stroke sloping down left that turns into a flat base, with a small dash at the right end of the base.

name: katakana-me
draw: Katakana me (メ): a long stroke curving down to the lower left crossed by a short stroke sloping down right.

name: katakana-mo
draw: Katakana mo (モ): two horizontal bars crossed by a vertical stem that turns right into a flat base.

name: katakana-ya
draw: Katakana ya (ヤ): a horizontal stroke hooking down at its right end, crossed by a long slanted stroke.

name: katakana-yu
draw: Katakana yu (ユ): a short top bar joined to a right upright and a long flat base that extends past both ends.

name: katakana-yo
draw: Katakana yo (ヨ): three horizontal bars joined by an upright on the right, like a backwards squared E.

name: katakana-ra
draw: Katakana ra (ラ): a short horizontal dash above a longer horizontal stroke that bends down into a hook to the lower left.

name: katakana-ri
draw: Katakana ri (リ): a short upright stroke on the left and a longer upright on the right curving down to the left.

name: katakana-ru
draw: Katakana ru (ル): a short curved stroke on the left and an upright on the right that flicks up to the right at its foot.

name: katakana-re
draw: Katakana re (レ): a single vertical stroke that turns at the bottom into a rising flick to the upper right.

name: katakana-wa
draw: Katakana wa (ワ): a short upright on the left joined at the top by a roof that bends down into a hook to the lower left.

name: katakana-wo
draw: Katakana wo (ヲ): two horizontal bars joined on the right by a stroke that bends down into a hook to the lower left.

name: katakana-n
draw: Katakana n (ン): a short dash at the upper left and a long stroke rising from the lower left to the upper right.

name: devanagari-aa
draw: Devanagari letter aa (आ): a curling 3 like stroke joined by a short bar to a vertical stem, with a second vertical stem on the right, under a flat headline.

name: devanagari-i
draw: Devanagari letter i (इ): a curling stroke like a hooked 5 hanging below a flat headline.

name: devanagari-ii
draw: Devanagari letter ii (ई): the curling i stroke under a headline with a small curved hook rising above the headline.

name: devanagari-u
draw: Devanagari letter u (उ): a curved stroke like a 3 whose lower curve sweeps into a tail to the right, hanging from a flat headline.

name: devanagari-uu
draw: Devanagari letter uu (ऊ): the u stroke under a headline with an extra curl hooking off its lower tail.

name: devanagari-vocalic-r
draw: Devanagari letter vocalic r (ऋ): a curled bowl hanging from a headline with a short hooked stroke dropping on its right.

name: devanagari-e
draw: Devanagari letter e (ए): a narrow angled curl like a backwards 7 folding back at the bottom, hanging below a short flat headline.

name: devanagari-ai
draw: Devanagari letter ai (ऐ): the e curl under a headline with a small slanted stroke rising above the headline.

name: devanagari-o
draw: Devanagari letter o (ओ): the aa shape of a curled bowl and vertical stem with a small slanted stroke rising above the headline over the stem.

name: devanagari-au
draw: Devanagari letter au (औ): the aa shape of a curled bowl and vertical stem with two small slanted strokes rising above the headline.

name: devanagari-ka
draw: Devanagari letter ka (क): a vertical stem through a headline with a small loop on the left and a curled hook on the right.

name: devanagari-kha
draw: Devanagari letter kha (ख): a small round loop on the left joined to a vertical stem on the right, under a headline.

name: devanagari-ga
draw: Devanagari letter ga (ग): two uprights under a headline, the left one short and hooked at its foot, the right one a full stem.

name: devanagari-gha
draw: Devanagari letter gha (घ): a small u shaped loop at the left joined to a tall vertical stem, with the headline over the stem only.

name: devanagari-nga
draw: Devanagari letter nga (ङ): a curled 3 like stroke hanging from a headline with a single dot to its right.

name: devanagari-cha
draw: Devanagari letter cha (च): a short horizontal stroke with a curled hook on the left joined to a vertical stem, under a headline.

name: devanagari-chha
draw: Devanagari letter chha (छ): two small stacked round loops hanging from a headline with a tail on the right and no stem.

name: devanagari-ja
draw: Devanagari letter ja (ज): a zigzag stroke like a backwards z joined to a vertical stem on the right, under a headline.

name: devanagari-jha
draw: Devanagari letter jha (झ): a curled 3 like stroke with an inner loop joined to a vertical stem on the right, under a headline.

name: devanagari-nya
draw: Devanagari letter nya (ञ): a curled stroke crossed by a horizontal bar running to a vertical stem on the right, under a headline.

name: devanagari-tta
draw: Devanagari letter tta (ट): a single rounded hook like a backwards c with a curled tail, hanging from a headline.

name: devanagari-ttha
draw: Devanagari letter ttha (ठ): a closed round loop hanging from a headline like a small o.

name: devanagari-dda
draw: Devanagari letter dda (ड): a curved stroke like a backwards c ending in a small curl at the lower right, hanging from a headline.

name: devanagari-ddha
draw: Devanagari letter ddha (ढ): two stacked curves like a small 3 with a hook at the bottom, hanging from a headline.

name: devanagari-nna
draw: Devanagari letter nna (ण): a loop on the left, a short horizontal bar and a tall vertical stem on the right, all under a headline.

name: devanagari-ta
draw: Devanagari letter ta (त): a short curved hook on the left joined by a horizontal stroke to a vertical stem, under a headline.

name: devanagari-tha
draw: Devanagari letter tha (थ): a small loop with a curl on the left joined to a vertical stem, under a headline that stops before the loop.

name: devanagari-da
draw: Devanagari letter da (द): a curled stroke like a hooked 2 with a small tail at the bottom hanging from a headline, with no stem.
